text: Collective of artists and curators devoted to cataloguing and proposing new forms of public presentation of artistic production, and which defends the radical mobility of its members in terms of belonging to the group.

Gd'E received the La Caixa 2020 Creation Support Grant, producing the book “Exhibition View”, and has carried out exhibition, performative, curatorial and mediation projects at La Virreina CI (Para k kieres saber eso?, 2021), at the gallery àngels barcelona espai 2 (Sala Grup d'Estudi, 2021), at MACBA (Marxandatge Grup d'Estudi, 2021 and Cheer, boo, fund, 2024), at CDLReus (Sala Grup d'Estudi Rosa Mangrané, 2022), at Index Foundation in Stockholm (Exhibition View Control Wars, 2022), at the Capella de Guarda-si-venes (I això què és, 2022), at Fundació Brossa (Carpa Grup d'Estudi, 2022 and Grup d'Estudi for you: Èxit through the Ale-hop, 2023), at Santa Mònica (La possibilitat de no haver sigut, 2023-2024), Exibart (Interferencias 1, 2024) and La Capella (Caixa sorpresa Grup d'Estudi, 2025).
